notes.title: V2 released
notes.content:
After a few years, I have updated the game once more. A few game breaking bugs have been brought to my attention, and with a LOT of research, it was partially the version of the engine and how I had things setup. I stepped away from working on the sequel, remake, and other projects to do this.

Fixed-
Level 3 boss area now will not stop you from entering the "Arena"
Parts of floor having no collision have had cement added to them
The poo will no longer fall from the sky
Monsters camping checkpoints have been removed/moved
Audio glitch of menu music playing through half game has been silenced
Final boss ganking you in the wrong level has been locked where he belongs
Drone boss de-buffed and super buffed at the same time

Not fixed-
NES sprite limit
Too many bullets sloooooowwwwwwwwwwssssss yoooooouuuuuu dddddoooooowwwwwwnnnnnn
Hey why am I invisible after I died?
Why do I have unlimited lives sometimes?
Ohhhh, if I try to backtrack I fall into limbo? (only on 1 section though)
The hidden warps are still not found? Weird...

What else? -
OR2 near end of dev, newer engine so less glitchy; but still NES limits
2 side games based on weird stuff? I am IN!
AN HD REMAKE BEING MADE?!? AND I GET IT FOR FREE WITH THE ORIGINAL?!?
Oh yay...a butt ton of reading with the new games...

More information to come, and if you find more bugs let me know. It may take a bit, as I am solo now.
Wil
